uncited: - Inputs: current frame color $C_{curr}$, historical frame color $C_{hist}$, nominal blend factor $\alpha$, maximum blend factor $\alpha_{max}$.
- History buffer storing accumulated color values per froxel.
Compute the difference between the current frame and the history: $\Delta = C_{curr} - C_{hist}$.
Determine the effective blend factor by capping the nominal factor: $\alpha_{eff} = \min(\alpha, \alpha_{max})$.
Update the history using the limited factor: $C_{hist}^{new} = C_{hist} + \alpha_{eff} \cdot \Delta$.
